The '''Coruscant Ballroom''' was a location on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. An event called Coruscant Nights took place there.

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], posters advertising [[Coruscant Nights/Legends|Coruscant Nights]] in the Ballroom were put on display in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]]. It showed the silhouette of two people against a [[Color/Legends|blue]] background and said "Coruscant Nights" at the top<ref name="Lethal" /> and "Coruscant Ballroom" at the bottom.<ref name="Lethal Trackdown">In "[[Lethal Trackdown]]," the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] text "Coruscant Ballroom" can be read at the bottom of a [[Painting/Legends|poster]] glimpsed over the entrance to [[Moshi Bar/Legends|Moshi Bar]] as [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] says, "You may be surprised what people reveal when they have been drinking." If you compare the design at bottom of this poster to the full poster seen ''inside'' the [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] (where only the "[[Coruscant Nights/Legends|Coruscant Nights]]" parts can be deciphered), you can see that it is the same poster, meaning that it reads "Coruscant Nights" at the top and "Coruscant Ballroom" at the bottom. The full version of the poster ''over the cantina entrance'' can also be seen in the wide shot of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] leaving the bar, but only from a distance.</ref>
